scope: One full RGB565 ChronoScreen draw kernel and six original Start/Process counter histories; not native game/GPU/full-scene parity.
assumptions: Original 53BBA0 and 53C0A0, LUT trig and _ftol run under process FPCW 0x0E7F on an 8x38 fixture; source/destination pitch is 10/11 words.
Start and Process execute whole bodies for durations -1,0,1,3,90 plus duration3 with Scenario+35A2 already set. The tactical fill rectangle is supplied (0,0,6,6), not a retail viewport.

Scenario pause starts false except the explicit prior-set contrast; the retained pause byte and native phase/counter writes are recorded. Pause sink values are fixture effects, not original Scenario Pause/Resume body proof.
No original gameplay/RNG loop, DirectDraw device, capture, UI render, audio device or complete ALL01 scene is executed.
substitutions: Existing Emu transport supplies synthetic surface dimensions, pitches, buffer Lock/Unlock and recorded DSurface constructor/copy/fill/delete sinks.
Lifecycle controls replace 53BBA0 with a recorded sink; the separate draw control executes its untouched original body and helper calls.

406E80,405BE0,406060,405C00,4060F0,7529A0,750920,7518C0,753570,753580 are recorded audio/mouse/platform sinks; 684240/684290 record and supply the fixture pause byte, 684060/684180 are recorded Scenario sinks.
4F42F0 and 4F4480 are recorded redraw sinks, including target surface, phase and A9FA94 capture guard. No renderer body is substituted in the separate native pixel kernel.
